_comment: Welcome email sent by the join app once a member has accepted the GitHub invitation (portal mode, share-prototype branch). Placeholders: {{name}} {{portal_url}}.
welcome_body:
Dear {{name}},

Welcome to MorphoCloud! Everything happens on your portal: {{portal_url}}

  1. Sign in with GitHub.
  2. Create your storage. You get 100 GB that stays when an instance is deleted; your Desktop, Documents and Downloads folders live there, and you can upload and download files from the portal at any time, with or without an instance. There is no backup.
  3. Create your instance. Choose an instance type (we advise the default, g3.large) and press Create instance. It is ready in 5 to 10 minutes; the portal shows the access details, and an email tells you when it is ready.

When you are done for the day, press Shelve; press Unshelve to start it again. A running instance shelves itself when its session runs out. Your instance has an expiry date, shown on the portal, and can be renewed there once.

If you get stuck, the User Guide has step-by-step instructions, the portal's Help card answers questions, and you can always reach us at portal@morphocloud.org.

Join the community. Questions, tips and troubleshooting live in MorphoCloud Discussions: browse or post in Q&A when you need help, and watch Announcements for service updates and events.

A note about emails: MorphoCloud's own emails (your instance is ready, expiry notices, outages) come from no-reply@morphocloud.org; add it to your safe senders. GitHub may also notify the address on your GitHub account about your request on GitHub; you can turn those off at github.com/settings/notifications without affecting MorphoCloud's emails.

Welcome aboard!
The MorphoCloud Team
